name: app-oviah-problem-statement-symptom-map-and-impact-cards
title: OVIAH period-tracker problem slide: a symptom callout illustration and four lilac impact cards
whatItIs: A white slide headed 'Period tracking is easy. Understanding your health isn't.' with a bullet list of consequences, a flat illustration of a woman with dotted lines pointing to symptoms (Cramps, PMS, Heavy Bleeding, Acne & Skin), and four lilac cards (Study, Work, Well-being, Daily Life) each with bullet impacts.
whatItMeans: Empathetic and evidence-based; mapping symptoms directly onto a figure makes an abstract health problem visceral.
techniques: Point dotted lines from a figure to named symptoms.
Group real-world impact into labelled category cards.
Pair a 'what' statement with a 'why it matters' section.

vocabulary.definition: An illustration linking a body to labelled symptoms.
A card grouping consequences of a problem by category.
